source_refs.note: Topic printed 8.4.2 Why is Intellectual Property Important? (PDF 203, printed 200); numbering slips back to 8.4.

blocks.text: Intellectual property protects people's ideas and creations so that they can profit from them. Knowing they will be rewarded encourages people to keep inventing and creating; IP supports creativity and progress. Pakistan has an Intellectual Property Organization (IPO) that registers and protects IP rights (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: What might happen to innovation if inventions could be copied freely?
blocks.explanation: Inventors could not recover their costs, so fewer people and companies would invest time and money in new ideas.

items: IP rewards creators and so encourages innovation; IPO Pakistan registers IP.
